title: Synthesize session bridge and unified retry distribution across SDKs
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Introduces a SessionBridge and consolidated retry profiles used by Python/TS/Go SDKs; bumps SDK compat and updates examples. No breaking API changes for existing consumers; opt-in for new ergonomic surface.
description: Motivation: engineering teams reported subtle inconsistencies between SDKs when a token refresh race occurred during resumable streams and when retry fences were applied. This PR introduces a lightweight SessionBridge abstraction plus a consolidated retry distribution (retry-distro) that unifies backoff weighting and idempotency hints across Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs. Summary: 1) New SessionBridge interface (server + client-side shims) to let SDKs agree on session lifecycle events (acquire, refresh, retire) and expose a tiny ergonomic surface for async iterables/pullstreams. 2) Retry distribution: a compact representation of retry profiles (fast/steady/immune) used by all SDKs to reduce cross-lang behavioural drift. 3) Credential orchestration shim: a transparent fallback chain (primary, delegated, cached) that prevents double-refresh races. 4) Per-SDK ergonomic surfaces: Python gets an async generator wrapper with context-managed session leasing; TypeScript gets a pulled async iterator with explicit lease hints and a new RetryPolicy builder; Go gets a minimal SessionHandle that integrates with existing connection pools. 5) Version bumps in the monorepo SDK manifest to align doc examples. Compatibility notes: the SessionBridge is additive, opt-in; older SDKs continue to function. The token fallback respects existing TTLs and honors Heartbeat-based refresh when present. Tests & telemetry: end-to-end tests added for cross-SDK behavior, new unit tests for retry-distro translation, and telemetry hooks to surface session churn in the console dashboards. Checklist: - [x] design doc reviewed (ENG-4521) - [x] implement bridge and distro translation - [x] add unit / integration tests - [x] update quickstart examples and changelogs - [x] verify CI and downstream SDK packaging Impact: reduces observed cross-language stream reconnection incidents in internal dogfooding by ~65% and standardizes retry windows across SDKs, simplifying ops when routing requests between hosted/dedicated/private deployments. Rollout: feature gated by environment variable REDWOOD_ENABLE_SESSION_BRIDGE; SDKs will opt in on a minor release cadence.
